tasks.description: Remove accepted local corpus query APIs and measure whether the loop recovers them.

variants.description: Full loop: candidate generation, patching, rollback, persistence, root broad gate, and THDSE core gate.

variants.description: Ablation: focused tests only, no broad regression gate.

variants.description: Ablation: root broad gate enabled but THDSE/Z3-focused core gate skipped.
